basic_details.job_title: IIM Lucknow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Junior Manager, Junior Programme Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is engaging three non-faculty professionals on a contractual basis, initially for three (03) years, at a total monthly consolidated emolument of Rs. 67,080 for each Junior Manager post and Rs. 44,340 for the Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I (Facility) post, HRA included in the total. Applications are accepted only through a Google Form on or before 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their application form on or before 7 December 2026 through the Google Form. No other mode for receipt of applications will be entertained.
Open the Google Form link given in the notice, listed in the links table below.
Provide a valid and active email ID. All communication related to the selection process is made only through email.
Enter the exact percentage of marks; rounding off is not allowed.
Submit the form on or before 7 December 2026. After final submission no request for modification or correction will be entertained.
The Institute is not responsible for incomplete submissions or technical issues at the candidate's end. Incomplete or incorrect information may lead to rejection.
Necessary certificate(s) for age relaxation, for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD applicants.

Original certificates, degrees and other documents on educational/professional qualifications, work experience, age and caste, to be produced by shortlisted candidates for verification at the time of the final selection process. Failure to do so may result in cancellation of candidature.
important_instructions: The Institute encourages applications from women candidates. The Institute is not responsible for delay or non-receipt of communication caused by an incorrect or inactive email ID. Candidates should check their inbox, including spam folders. In case of an inadvertent mistake in the selection process, detected at any stage even after issue of the appointment letter, the Institute may modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to applicants. The Institute reserves the right to modify, amend or cancel the recruitment process, in part or in full, at any stage without assigning any reason, and not to fill any or all of the advertised posts. No interim correspondence will be entertained or replied to. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Legal disputes, if any, will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Lucknow only. Updates, amendments and corrigenda will be placed only on the Institute website, www.iiml.ac.in.

Junior Manager (Network and Security Administrator); Junior Manager (Website Front-End Developer); Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I (Facility)
Rs. 67,080 total per month for each Junior Manager post; Rs. 44,340 total per month for Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I
Lucknow (Institute address: Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow-226 013 (U.P.) India)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three posts with one vacancy each, so the total is 3. The notice prints no category-wise break-up. The Institute may increase or decrease the number of posts as per its need.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens are eligible. Eligibility must be met as on the closing date for receipt of online applications; otherwise the application will be summarily rejected. The crucial date for the age limit is also the closing date for receipt of applications. No rounding off of percentage is allowed; candidates must enter the exact percentage of marks in the form. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and responsive frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind). Hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js). Proven experience in CMS integration, customization, and template/theme development. Familiarity with AI/ML APIs and ability to integrate AI-driven features on the front end. Good understanding of SEO practices, accessibility compliance, and website performance optimization. Experience with Git/GitHub/GitLab and CI (Continuous Integration) /CD (Continuous Delivery/Deployment) workflows for front-end deployments. Experience: minimum 7 years of relevant experience in facility management at a recognized sports Institution or a reputed Government/Academic Institution, involving the supervision and management of a facility centre comprising infrastructure such as an auditorium and sports facilities, including squash, billiards, swimming pool, etc. The candidate should have sound knowledge and experience in monitoring, maintaining and managing sports equipment. The candidate should have knowledge of medical exercises, which can improve the health of every individual. Age relaxation: the age limit is relaxable for candidates of the SC/ST/OBC/PwBD category as per Central Government rules. Such applicants have to attach the necessary certificate(s) as prescribed by the Government of India. The notice does not give the relaxation in years. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are monthly consolidated amounts with a fixed HRA, shown in the vacancy table. The positions are purely contractual in nature, initially for three (03) years, extendable/renewable annually, subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbent and the continuing requirement of the Institute. Candidates have no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIML Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their application form on or before 7 December 2026 through the Google Form. No other mode for receipt of applications will be entertained. Open the Google Form link given in the notice, listed in the links table below. Provide a valid and active email ID. All communication related to the selection process is made only through email. Enter the exact percentage of marks; rounding off is not allowed. Submit the form on or before 7 December 2026. After final submission no request for modification or correction will be entertained. The Institute is not responsible for incomplete submissions or technical issues at the candidate's end. Incomplete or incorrect information may lead to rejection. Documents named in the notice: Necessary certificate(s) for age relaxation, for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD applicants. Original certificates, degrees and other documents on educational/professional qualifications, work experience, age and caste, to be produced by shortlisted candidates for verification at the time of the final selection process. Failure to do so may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection may be made through a Written Test, Skill Test and/or Personal Interview, as decided by the Competent Authority. The mode of selection may be offline or online, as decided by the Institute. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of shortlisted candidates to a reasonable number based on higher qualifications and/or experience or any other criteria. The date(s) for the selection process will be communicated later, only to shortlisted candidates, through email. The panel of recommended candidates will be valid for one year from the date of approval of the Competent Authority. The Institute can make appointments in the future by operating the panel within that period. No TA/DA or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to attend the Interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute encourages applications from women candidates. The Institute is not responsible for delay or non-receipt of communication caused by an incorrect or inactive email ID. Candidates should check their inbox, including spam folders. In case of an inadvertent mistake in the selection process, detected at any stage even after issue of the appointment letter, the Institute may modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to applicants. The Institute reserves the right to modify, amend or cancel the recruitment process, in part or in full, at any stage without assigning any reason, and not to fill any or all of the advertised posts. No interim correspondence will be entertained or replied to. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Legal disputes, if any, will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Lucknow only. Updates, amendments and corrigenda will be placed only on the Institute website, www.iiml.ac.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Junior Manager (Network and Security Administrator), one Junior Manager (Website Front-End Developer) and one Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I (Facility).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 December 2026 (07.12.2026). Applications are accepted only through the Google Form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIML Junior Manager posts?
faq.answer: B.Tech/BE or M.Tech/ME/MCA (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics from a reputed Institute/University in regular mode with a minimum 60% marks, plus minimum 1-2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I (Facility)?
faq.answer: A graduate in any discipline from a recognized Institution/University, with minimum 7 years of relevant experience in facility management at a recognized sports Institution or a reputed Government/Academic Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for both Junior Manager posts and 50 years for Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I. Age is counted on the closing date for receipt of applications, and SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates get relaxation as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for IIML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Each Junior Manager post carries Rs. 60,000 plus fixed HRA of Rs. 7,080, a total of Rs. 67,080 a month. Jr. Programme Assistant Gr. I carries Rs. 40,000 plus fixed HRA of Rs. 4,340, a total of Rs. 44,340.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly consolidated emoluments?
faq.answer: The notice shows the HRA as a fixed amount (Rs. 7,080 or Rs. 4,340) and includes it in the stated total (Rs. 67,080 or Rs. 44,340) for each post.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for IIML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Form given in the notice on or before 7 December 2026. No other mode of application is entertained, and no correction is allowed after final submission.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection may be made through a Written Test, Skill Test and/or Personal Interview, as decided by the Competent Authority. Dates will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by email.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely contractual, initially for three (03) years and extendable/renewable annually. Candidates have no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute.
